URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/(BBC Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg coverage 17 May 2026)
TITLE: Lisa Nandy says Labour leadership talk is "froth and nonsense"
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-17 Sunday morning
SOURCE: BBC (Becky Morton)

KEY QUOTES — LISA NANDY ON BBC SUNDAY WITH LAURA KUENSSBERG:
- Leadership challenge speculation is "froth and nonsense"
- Whether to fight a contest is a "personal decision" for Starmer
- "wouldn't write off the prime minister"
- "shown before that he's up for a fight"
- "I think that we were elected to bring an end to the chaos"
- Rejected idea Starmer should be replaced
- No candidate has launched a challenge to Keir Starmer despite "feverish speculation" around Burnham and Streeting

CONTEXT:
- Nandy out campaigning with Burnham in Makerfield by-election (Saturday — first Cabinet minister to do so)
- Supports Burnham being "back in Parliament at the heart of power"
- Josh Simons (Labour MP) said losing Makerfield would be "existential" for Labour
- Kemi Badenoch: "It doesn't matter whether it's Andy Burnham or Keir Starmer, the problem is the Labour Party"

ON STREETING EU REJOIN CALL:
- Nandy called Streeting's comments "odd"
- "if the answer to all of this was the European Union, then essentially we'd be saying to people what was going on in 2015 in towns like Wigan was absolutely fine... Well, I can tell you that it wasn't."
